assessment: The Analysis is traceable to the Synthesis and remains within the frozen Methodological scope. It explicitly labels the ontology+facets architecture as a proposed working design rather than an existing standard taxonomy; separates the six upstream entity roles from the six normalized core facets; states that the normalization is an analysis/design judgment; retains provisional treatment of diagnostics/sensitivity, causal discovery, and specialized settings; and requires representative-method-corpus iteration before facet characteristics can be considered MECE or the taxonomy complete. The comparator judgments against a single tree and a pure faceted model are supported by the documented non-exclusivity and abstraction-level constraints, and no method-performance ranking is introduced. No semantic overreach or context-boundary violation was identified.
